name: mirage
text: Checked the P/L code before building. Daily and all-time on the Tracker already come from Novig's wallet records per game day, with open bets left out. That is what you described, so there's nothing left to build for it. The numbers that disagreed were two different measures on the Engine card. 'Equity' is cash plus the engine's own at-risk ledger. 'Positions' are the whole account marked at last trades. The Tracker never used either. I'm not shipping a release for that alone. If the Tracker still shows a wrong number, send me the figure and the time and I'll trace it.
